deskNotes.text: Bitcoin is currently trading independently of the Nasdaq while absorbing massive short squeezes that have generated over two billion dollars in weekly spot ETF inflows. The market bias remains aggressively bullish as institutional dry powder activates alongside a stablecoin supply expansion exceeding three hundred and ten billion dollars, creating liquidity tailwinds unseen in previous cycles. However, extreme overbought conditions are flashing warning signs with the BTC RSI at eighty-three and SOL hitting an alarming eighty-seven on the four-hour chart. This technical divergence is evident as price makes new highs while momentum indicators turn negative for both Bitcoin and Ethereum. The confluence of ETF inflows and short liquidations creates a self-reinforcing upward spiral, yet dollar liquidity is contracting which forces risk assets into a macro headwind that demands more proof on continuation longs. Treat failed rallies as better-odds shorts rather than fading strength without a real mechanism like overheated funding or supply unlocks. The tape remains up-trending with the primary signal being a decoupling from traditional equities while macro data stays neutral to slightly dovish. Institutional flows continue to drive price action even as headlines report on Treasury plans to deploy nearly one trillion dollars for bond buybacks starting September nine to suppress yields. While FOLD drops over twenty-six percent and regulatory pressure escalates with sanctions on Iranian ties, the core narrative of institutional adoption persists through tokenized stocks rolling out on Base. Traders must recognize that a high-conviction long requires a real catalyst while counter-trend shorts are only viable at exhaustion points where euphoria readings become unsustainable.

column.text: Bitcoin is currently trading independently of the Nasdaq while absorbing massive short squeezes that have generated over two billion dollars in weekly spot ETF inflows. The market bias remains aggressively bullish as institutional dry powder activates alongside a stablecoin supply expansion exceeding three hundred and ten billion dollars, creating liquidity tailwinds unseen in previous cycles. However, extreme overbought conditions are flashing warning signs with the BTC RSI at eighty-three and SOL hitting an alarming eighty-seven on the four-hour chart. This technical divergence is evident as price makes new highs while momentum indicators turn negative for both Bitcoin and Ethereum. The confluence of ETF inflows and short liquidations creates a self-reinforcing upward spiral, yet dollar liquidity is contracting which forces risk assets into a macro headwind that demands more proof on continuation longs. Treat failed rallies as better-odds shorts rather than fading strength without a real mechanism like overheated funding or supply unlocks. The tape remains up-trending with the primary signal being a decoupling from traditional equities while macro data stays neutral to slightly dovish. Institutional flows continue to drive price action even as headlines report on Treasury plans to deploy nearly one trillion dollars for bond buybacks starting September nine to suppress yields. While FOLD drops over twenty-six percent and regulatory pressure escalates with sanctions on Iranian ties, the core narrative of institutional adoption persists through tokenized stocks rolling out on Base. Traders must recognize that a high-conviction long requires a real catalyst while counter-trend shorts are only viable at exhaustion points where euphoria readings become unsustainable.
